audit.why: Both layers already read Skill / Skill / Ambessa / K'Sante / Ambessa / Ambessa / K'Sante, matching the mirror's corrected chart and every why on the page. Only the packet's row 3 differs (Skill), and the mirror deliberately set it to K'Sante.
audit.corrected: Chart left alone — no new disagreement introduced.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike was described only as 'her ultimate' with no numbers, and the two-item plan ignored her healing.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s — the longest cooldown on either side of the lane, and it heals her. Grievous Wounds timing is what decides the extended fights the two-item plan relies on.
audit.corrected: 130s written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d; a Grievous Wounds component written into wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME: the entire full layer tracks 'Repeating Dashes', which is not an Ambessa ability. Her kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). The layer also called Ntofo Strikes a 'Q3 knockup' and used male pronouns for Ambessa.
audit.why: Repudiation shields her and deals increased damage if it braced any non-minion damage, so opening into it is the worst possible sequence. Ntofo Strikes fires its shockwave at TWO stacks and PULLS — dragging her into your marked follow-up, not knocking her up.
audit.corrected: Every 'Repeating Dashes' replaced with the real ability; Repudiation's shield-and-brace punish, Lacerate's dash-slow, and the two-stack pull now stated. Pronouns fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said where Public Execution picks its target.
audit.why: Riot's text: she blinks to the FARTHEST enemy champion in a line of her choosing. Standing behind your own wave or team makes you the pick, which is a positioning rule you can act on.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' was a fabricated ability name repeated across roughly twenty full-layer fields — the worst error found in this slice. All of them are replaced.
